oracle.go_code_path: internal/cli/unlock.go resolveConfig -> internal/cli/configfix.go InteractiveFixConfig -> internal/cli/input/input.go ConfirmInteractive (bufio.NewReader(os.Stdin).ReadString('\n') per prompt)

note: R9 (ADR 0037). Each case runs the oracle binary in a sandbox with the frozen vault whose config.yaml got `clipboard:\n    auto_clear_duration: -5\n` appended, SYMVAULT_PASSPHRASE + SYMVAULT_ALLOW_ENV_PASSPHRASE=1, EDITOR=<root>/editor.sh (`exit 0`), PATH=/usr/bin:/bin, CI=1, NO_COLOR=1, TZ=UTC, stdin = the scripted bytes. Darwin and linux (gate image) recordings were byte-identical and are stored once. `config_after_id` indexes `configs` (config.yaml after the run). Commands without `BodyRuns` only get declining answers: intake, broker, ui and mcp serve would run a listener, a TUI or a desktop notification, generate --store prints a random password, and `add` on a non-terminal stdin is a different residual (Go prompts line by line, Rust refuses).
